image.alt: The Great Wall of China winding across steep mountain ridges with crenellated stone parapets.

watchtower.alt: Multi-story square stone watchtower along the Great Wall with arched observation windows.

rampart-road.alt: Paved rampart road on top of the Great Wall wide enough for marching troops and carts.

ruined-section.alt: Ancient eroded rammed-earth section of frontier wall in a semi-arid mountain pass.
